pages.text: $(thing)Take-all$() ($(o)Gaeumannomyces tritici$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() common wheat, durum wheat, barley.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne, crop residue.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 10-25 °C (best 18 °C), pH below 8.5, pH above 6.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 50% yield, can kill the plant.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() One-year break with a non-grass crop; Avoid over-liming; Ammonium rather than nitrate nitrogen; Take-all decline after continuous wheat.
Worse in alkaline, freshly limed, loose or waterlogged soils.
